# Diler Services

> Florida LLC formation, EIN filing, and registered agent service for founders and small business owners nationwide. Diler Services LLC is not a law firm and does not give legal or tax advice.

## Primary identity
- Brand: Diler Services
- Legal name: Diler Services LLC
- Category: Florida business formation and registered agent
- Email: info@dilerservices.com
- Languages: English and Spanish

## Services
- LLC formation in Florida
- Florida registered agent
- EIN filing
- Formation and EIN bundle
- Annual report, DBA, amendment, and reinstatement

## Key facts
- LLC formation: $89 service fee, plus the $125 Florida state fee at cost
- Formation bundle: $299 total, including the state fee and EIN filing
- EIN filing: $95. The IRS issues the number at no charge
- Registered agent: $13.99 per month or $169 per year, billed separately from formation and the bundle
- Filings are submitted within one business day of complete information
- If that window is missed, the $89 formation service fee is refunded
- State fees are not refundable once a filing has been submitted
- A rejected business name is refiled, with the name the client chooses, at no additional service fee
- Not a law firm. No legal or tax advice
- Service is available in English and in Spanish
